limits: DataHora strings remain literal naive local times; timezone and gauge datum not certified.
No record publication/receipt-time history; sources may contain retrospective revisions.
Source QC approved does not certify physical truth; suspect/negative/raw missing values preserved.
Exact15min absence is not automatically failure for hourly stations; modal cadence is descriptive.
Conflicting versions retained, no automatic preference. No interpolation/rounding/zero fill/unit conversion.
2021/2022 remain reserved from fitting/tuning/model selection; collection does not constitute evaluation.
